{{Quote|It never ends... it never ends. I must admit, though, that I'll be relieved when my part in this is finally over. Coordinating the release of Imperial hostages has its challenges but also a high level of stress. After my retirement, I think I'll get a little place on Naboo near Kaadara.|Colonel Darkstone|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Darkstone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], who served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
While serving with the Imperial Military, Darkstone was based at the [[Imperial Oasis]], a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Darkstone was on the verge of retirement, when [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]], an Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Despite Bledsoe's whole-hearted support for the Empire's xenophobic views, the Zabrak felt it was his duty to make sure all Imperial hostages were freed before he gave up his post.

Fortunately for Colonel Darkstone, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and a group of ragtag Imperial supporters stepped forward to assist. However, before the Imperials could rescue the doctor, Darkstone needed them to find prisoner transfer orders. After searching various locations, including a [[Droid Engineer's Cave]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], the [[Mokk Stronghold]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and the [[Palace of the Woolamander|Woolamander Palace]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the Imperials finally found the documents Darkstone sought. The Imperials learned that Bledsoe was being transported on a Rebel [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]]. The only option would be to infiltrate the corvette, and carry out a daring rescue operation. In order to save the doctor before anything bad happened to him, the Imperials were immediately given a ticket to hand to an Imperial [[TIE pilot]] at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]].

From here, the Imperials were flown on a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] to the corvette. After boarding the corvette, the Imperials fought their way through the corridors, and rescued Bledsoe. After evacuating the corvette through the ship's escape pods, the Imperials returned to Darkstone, and were commended for their service. The [[Imperial Valorous Services Medal]] was awarded to the Imperials for their exemplary work.

==Behind the scenes==
Darkstone is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, players may take a mission from him which involves rescuing Doctor Bledsoe from a corvette. After completing the mission, the players are given a badge, a schematic for an [[AV-21 Landspeeder]] and several other rewards.
